import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

# So horizontal uses color order, vertical uses scan order? Test both variants on test input and pick per aspect ratio.

def f(g, vertical=True):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; lst=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cells=[(i,j)]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft()
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in cells and g[ny][nx]==c:
                            cells.append((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[y for y,_ in cells]; xs=[x for _,x in cells]
                y0=min(ys); x0=min(xs)
                sset=set(cells)
                h=max(ys)-y0+1; w=max(xs)-x0+1
                crop=[[c if (y0+yy,x0+xx) in sset else 0 for xx in range(w)] for yy in range(h)]
                lst.append((crop,(i,j)))
    uniq={}; res=[]
    for cr,pos in lst:
        t=tuple(map(tuple,cr))
        if t not in uniq: uniq[t]=(pos,cr)
    if vertical:
        res=sorted(uniq.values(), key=lambda kv:kv[0])  # scan order
    else:
        def colkey(cr): return max(set(v for r_ in cr for v in r_ if v))
        res=sorted(uniq.values(), key=lambda kv:colkey(kv[1]))
    out=[]
    for pos,cr in res:
        out += [row[:] for row in cr]
    return out
for a,b,vert in (('Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 1 output',0),('Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 2 output',1),('Demo pair 3 input','Demo pair 3 output',1)):

    print(a,'match:',o==p,'shape',len(o),'x',len(o[0]) if o else 0,'expected',len(p),'x',len(p[0]))
